items.title: Both participants’ different reactions are visible
items.precondition: An isolated runtime has two signed-in users in the same direct conversation.
steps: User A sends a text message.
User B reacts with one available emoji.
User A reacts to that same message with a different available emoji.
Observe the message in both users’ open threads, including after a realtime update or refresh.
items.expected: Both bubbles show the two distinct emoji icons in one compact reaction badge; neither participant’s reaction hides the other.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: user confirmed the tested two-user conversation shows both distinct reactions on the same message.

items.title: Matching reactions show the participant count
items.precondition: An isolated runtime has the same two-user conversation.
steps: Have User A and User B choose the same emoji on one message.
Observe the badge in both threads.
items.expected: The badge shows one instance of the emoji and a visible count of 2, without duplicate icons or loss of either reaction.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: user confirmed matching participant reactions remain visible with their count.

items.title: Bubble and status layout remain intact
items.precondition: An isolated runtime includes incoming and outgoing text, image-only, grouped, and themed messages with reaction summaries.
steps: Check incoming and outgoing bubbles with one and two visible reaction types.
Check a sent message that shows delivered or seen status at desktop and narrow mobile widths.
items.expected: Reaction badges remain attached to the correct bubble edge with clear separation from nearby bubbles and no overlap with timestamp, image, toolbar, or delivery/seen status.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: user confirmed the final badge appearance and text readability in the tested chat theme.

items.title: Frontend quality gates
steps: Run npm run typecheck in frontend/.
Run npm run lint in frontend/.
Run npm run build in frontend/.
items.expected: All commands succeed; any unrelated pre-existing warning is documented rather than attributed to this change.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: npm run typecheck and npm run build exited 0. npm run lint exited 0 with six existing warnings in PostDetailPage, PostPhotoCommentsPage, AuthContext, ThemeContext, and MessageQuoteStrip; none are in this change.
items.notes: Vite also reported its existing advisory that the production JavaScript chunk exceeds 500 kB.
